property.name: objectApiName
property.description: API name of the object to use. Must match exactly, case sensitive.

property.name: fieldString
property.description: Comma separated list of fields to use. Must use their API name, and the name must match exactly (case sensitive).

property.name: record
property.description: Contains the resulting record after fields are updated on the form. Can also be used as an input to default the form.

property.name: padding
property.description: Padding around each cell in the layout (see documentation around the lightnin-layout-item for further reference.

property.name: largeDeviceSize
property.description: Based on the Lightning Design System grid. Size of each column, when rendered on a large device. If 12 is specified, cell takes up entire content area, 8 takes up 3/4s of content area, 6 takes up half, etc.

property.name: smallDeviceSize
property.description: Based on the Lightning Design System grid. Size of each column, when rendered on a medium device. If 12 is specified, cell takes up entire content area, 8 takes up 3/4s of content area, 6 takes up half, etc.

property.name: mediumDeviceSize
property.description: Based on the Lightning Design System grid. Size of each column, when rendered on a small device. If 12 is specified, cell takes up entire content area, 8 takes up 3/4s of content area, 6 takes up half, etc.

property.name: showSpinner
property.description: Determines whether to display a spinner when the component is loading.

property.name: variant
property.description: Determines where the label is displayed (see lightning record edit form for more information). Default is label-stacked
